title: Flat morphisms are local on the source for the étale topology
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.5.12: the property of being a flat morphism between nonconnective spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks is local on the source with respect to the étale topology.

difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 26 is a concrete étale-local descent argument: condition (i) is immediate from the definition of flatness; for condition (ii), it reduces to an arbitrary étale square Spec B → Y ← Spec A, uses joint surjectivity to choose finite étale maps B → Bβ with B → ∏β Bβ faithfully flat and each Spec Bβ → Spec B → Y factoring through some Xα, concludes each Bβ is flat over A, hence ∏β Bβ is flat over A, and applies Lemma 1.5.13 to descend flatness to B over A. This is non-routine local flatness material, but a supporting locality result rather than an H3 main construction.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Finite faithfully flat étale refinement of an arbitrary étale square, flatness of the product, and descent of flatness via Lemma 1.5.13.
